audit.whatIsWrong: Every chart row contradicts the page's own whys[]: win[]/phases[].side gave Yasuo levels 1, 2, 3 and 6 while whys[0..4] all say Illaoi owns them.
audit.why: The mirror states Illaoi takes Level 1 through First item and Yasuo takes 2+ items. The whys[] already read that way for rows 0-4. Rows 4 and 5 also carry the wrong stage labels ('Level 5', 'Level 6' against rows Level 6 and First item).
audit.corrected: All seven rows aligned in both layers as one group with ratings rescaled; whys[4] and whys[5] rewritten.

audit.why: Tentacle Smash 10/9/8/7/6, Harsh Lesson 4s flat, Test of Spirit 16/15/14/13/12, Leap of Faith 120/95/70, Last Breath 70/50/30.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[0], spikes[1], early, phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Test of Spirit is called her W in five places — it is her E. Harsh Lesson is the W, and its auto reset is never mentioned. 'Last Breath converts ANY knockup' is false here.
audit.why: Kit: Q Tentacle Smash, W Harsh Lesson (a 4s leap that resets her auto and makes nearby tentacles swing), E Test of Spirit, R Leap of Faith. A player told to 'Wind Wall her W' will wall a melee leap. The Harsh Lesson wind-up is the real burst tell. Nothing in her kit knocks her airborne, so Last Breath only follows your own two-stack Steel Tempest whirlwind.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected throughout; Harsh Lesson named as the auto-reset tell; Q2 whirlwind named as the only Last Breath setup.

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemisation line reads 'Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern', which names the wrong side's healing.
audit.why: Yasuo has no healing. The heal is Illaoi's: Prophet of an Elder God heals her whenever a tentacle damages a champion. Anti-heal is correct here, but the reason on the page is wrong.
audit.corrected: Reason rewritten to name her tentacle healing; Grievous Wounds also tied to mid and spikes[3].

edits.before: Level 5 stays hers as her E and tentacle damage peak before your spikes.
edits.after: Level 6 stays hers as Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle wall around you.

edits.before: Illaoi wrecks you if you stand near her tentacles — a landed Test of Spirit (W) or Tentacle Smash punishes every trade, and her passive tentacles shred you in the open. Dodge Test of Spirit and never trade inside a tentacle field.
edits.after: Illaoi wrecks you near her tentacles — Test of Spirit is her E on 16s at rank 1, and Harsh Lesson (W) is a 4s leap that also resets her auto. Dodge the E, never trade inside a tentacle field, and note her passive heals off every tentacle hit.

edits.before: Leap of Faith (R) spawns a wall of tentacles; if she ults into you with no escape, disengage — but your R comes online too, and a caught Illaoi outside her tentacles dies to Q3-into-Last Breath.
edits.after: Leap of Faith (R, 120s at rank 1) spawns a tentacle for every champion hit — disengage rather than trade into it. Last Breath needs YOUR Q2 whirlwind; nothing she casts lifts her.

edits.before: Your crit and Sweeping Blade let you kite her slow tentacles and burst her when she's away from them; Wind Wall her Test of Spirit projectile to deny the whole combo.
edits.after: Your crit and Sweeping Blade let you kite her tentacles and burst her away from them; the Harsh Lesson wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step out of range.

edits.before: You out-mobility and out-DPS her in the open — the entire matchup is not fighting inside tentacles and Wind Walling her W so she can't rip your spirit.
edits.after: You out-mobility and out-DPS her in the open — the whole matchup is refusing to fight inside tentacles and buying Grievous Wounds for her passive heal.

edits.before: Illaoi owns the early levels — her tentacles and Tentacle Smash out-trade you, and a single Test of Spirit (W) rips your spirit and zones you off the wave. Farm from range, dodge her W religiously, and never trade while standing in a tentacle field.
edits.after: Illaoi owns the early levels — her tentacles and Tentacle Smash out-trade you, and a single Test of Spirit (E, 16s at rank 1) rips your spirit and zones you off the wave. Farm from range, dodge her E religiously, and never trade inside a tentacle field.

edits.before: Through Levels 3-5 she stays ahead as her tentacle count and E threat grow; any melee trade near her tentacles is a losing one. This whole stretch is about spacing — Wind Wall the Test of Spirit and wait for your item and ult timings to arrive.
edits.after: Through 3-5 she stays ahead as her tentacle count and E threat grow; any melee trade near her tentacles loses. This stretch is about spacing — her passive heals her off every tentacle hit, so buy Grievous Wounds and wait for your item timings.

edits.before: From 6 the matchup flips to you: your R lands and a caught Illaoi outside her tentacles dies to Q3 into Last Breath. With items your crit and Sweeping Blade let you kite her slow tentacles and burst her in the open, and Wind Wall shuts down her W entirely.
edits.after: Only from two items does the matchup flip: your crit and Sweeping Blade let you kite her tentacles and burst her in the open, and Last Breath off your own Q2 whirlwind kills a caught Illaoi. Until then, refuse every fight inside her field.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Illaoi's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Last Breath (70s at rank 1) fires only off your own Q2 whirlwind. Leap of Faith is 120s and spawns tentacles on you.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window — build your teamfight around that. Illaoi carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Last Breath needs an airborne target and only your own Q2 whirlwind supplies one. Illaoi carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal against her tentacle healing stays core; shift to picks if she leads.

edits.before: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — Skillshot — Wind Wall blocks it! Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Illaoi Test of Spirit (E): 16s at rank 1 — the skillshot the whole lane turns on. - Harsh Lesson is 4s and resets her auto; the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Blade of the Ruined King  (duel spike), then Infinity Edge; boots Plated Steelcaps. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Blade of the Ruined King (duel spike), then Infinity Edge; boots Plated Steelcaps. Executioner's Calling early — her tentacles heal her off every hit.

notes: Test of Spirit was labelled (W) throughout — it is her E, and Harsh Lesson is the W. That mislabel is what makes 'Wind Wall her W' actively harmful advice, since Harsh Lesson is a melee leap. UNVERIFIED and left exactly as the page had it, matching the mirror's decision: whether Wind Wall blocks Test of Spirit. Illaoi's E carries no projectile flag and Riot's text does not settle it, so I neither strengthened nor removed that claim in tldr, winCon, dosFull[0..1], wants.you[0] or breakdown.trading. suspectNames flagged 'Wind Walling' and 'Land Test of Spirit' — both false positives.
